steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The massive high school towers over all the other
buildings in this bustling urban area.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It's like the school stands at the center of the
entire world.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Hope's Peak Academy...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It brings in top students from every field imaginable.
A government-funded school of privilege...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>They say that if you come here and manage to graduate,
you'll be set for life.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>With hundreds of years of tradition, it sends the
cream of the crop into the work force every year.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was built to raise <CLT><CLT 3>hope<CLT><CLT 4> in the nation's future.
Which makes <CLT><CLT 3>Hope's Peak<CLT><CLT 4> a pretty fitting name.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>There are two things you need to attend this school...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>One, you have to already be attending high school.
Two, you have to be the very best at what you do.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>No ordinary student could enroll here. The only way in
is if you're scouted by the school itself.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And standing there at the gate of the ultimate school
filled with the ultimate students...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi (Thought)
steps.text:
<CLT 4>...was me.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Before we go any farther, I guess I should introduce
myself. My name's <CLT 3>Makoto Naegi<CLT>.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>As you can see, I'm nothing but a hopelessly average
high school student.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Average on the outside, average on the inside.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I really don't have much going for me when it comes to
grades, special abilities, even personality.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I mean yeah, I have hobbies and stuff I like to do,
but it's not like I'm a psychic or mutant or whatever.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Like, if you asked me what my favorite song was,
or my favorite movie or TV show...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>They'd all just be whatever's most popular at that
particular moment.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Even among the average, I'm completely average. So I
can't even say I'm your "everyday hero" type.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>That's just who I am.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Anyway, I figure it's always good to introduce
yourself right off the bat.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But you know, if I have any kind of "strong point," so
to speak...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I'd say I'm a little more gung-ho than other people.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I mean look at me. I'm completely ordinary, but
still...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Here I am, standing in front of the anything but
ordinary Hope's Peak Academy.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I still can't believe I'm standing here. I wonder if
someone like me can survive in a place like this...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It's got this overwhelming presence...like it's trying
to swallow me whole.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But it's no wonder I would feel that way. What you
have to understand is...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Well, let me just tell you about the "<CLT><CLT 3>preparation<CLT><CLT 4>" I
did last night to get ready for today.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Hope's Peak only invites those students who are the
truly elite in their field.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It's such a popular topic, there are threads online
dedicated to talking about the school's attendees.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>So to prepare, I looked up some of those threads.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And all I saw was talk about "<CLT><CLT 3>ultimate<CLT><CLT 4>" students,
who were way beyond your average high schooler.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>For example, one incoming student is the "<CLT><CLT 3>Ultimate
Pop Sensation<CLT><CLT 4>."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I guess she's a high school girl who's also the lead
singer for a pop group famous all over the country.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>There's also the "<CLT><CLT 3>Ultimate Baseball Star<CLT><CLT 4>."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>He was the cleanup hitter for the national high school
champs. Pro teams already have their eyes on him.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Then there's the "<CLT><CLT 3>Ultimate Fashionista<CLT><CLT 4>."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>She's been on the cover of tons of fashion magazines.
She's what every high school girl wants to be.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Oh, and they mentioned the "<CLT><CLT 3>Ultimate Biker Gang
Leader<CLT><CLT 4>" too.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The scary thing is, he's the de facto leader of every
biker gang in Japan. Gangs everywhere love the guy...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>On top of that, there's the Ultimate Martial Artist,
the Ultimate Fanfic Creator, the Ultimate Gambler...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The Ultimate Swimming Pro, the Ultimate Programmer,
the Ultimate Clairvoyant, and then some...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Reading that made me realize how totally powerless I
was. It was the country's finest, top to bottom.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I felt like a tame little house cat who'd wandered
into a pride of lions.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But still, there was something I couldn't stop
thinking about.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>You see, there were a few students who I couldn't find
any info on, no matter how much I looked.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>With all those "ultimate" students, I'm the only one
without any kind of worthwhile talent.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But then, what about those other new students who
didn't seem to pop up anywhere?
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
Could they be just average students like me, without
any talent or anything?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>That thought was kind of encouraging. I mean, I know I
don't have much in the way of personality.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But beyond that, there's an even bigger issue...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>How did such an unbelievably average student like me
get picked to come to this "ultimate" high school?
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I mean, I guess there *is* a reason...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>You just have to take one glance at the acceptance
letter they sent me to see why.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>"We recently held a lottery to select one ordinary
student to attend our school."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>"As a result, you have been selected, and we invite
you to join us as the <CLT><CLT 3>Ultimate Lucky Student<CLT><CLT 4>."
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>They spelled it out plain as day—I got invited by
<CLT><CLT 3>pure luck<CLT><CLT 4>.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Honestly, I probably would have been better off just
declining their offer.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But after hearing how graduating was a "<CLT><CLT 3>guarantee for
success<CLT><CLT 4>" later in life, I just couldn't say no.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But then, actually standing there in front of the
school...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I started to feel lost, like I didn't belong there. I
could feel myself losing my nerve.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
But still...I can't just stand here in front of the
gate forever...

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Frozen in place, murmuring to myself, I looked down at
the acceptance letter clutched in my hand.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It said there'd be a meeting for all incoming students
in the <CLT><CLT 3>main hall at 8 a.m.<CLT><CLT 4>
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The meeting still isn't for a little while, but...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: I should probably just head in.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: Yeah... Yeah, let's do this!

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I gathered up all my determination and tried to act
like I'd done this a million times before.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And I took my first step toward the main hall...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
This is where we're supposed to meet, right? I guess
I'm the first one here.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>There's a really elegant clock over in the corner. It
says it's 7:10 a.m.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The meeting doesn't start until 8 o'clock. So there's
still a full 50 minutes left.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It makes sense nobody else would be here yet...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: I was so wound up, I got here way too early.

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I have plenty of time before the meeting. Just
standing around waiting isn't exactly...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>I should take a look around the school. Maybe that'll
help me calm down a little.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
I *am* a student here now, so there shouldn't be any
problem with me having a look around, right?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It'll help me kill some time, if nothing else.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Trying to play it cool, I took my first step into
Hope's Peak Academy.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was also my first step toward starting a new life
at a new school.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>...At least, that's what I was hoping for.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text: What the—!?

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>But the instant I took that first step forward...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>My view became warped, twisted.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was like some kind of delusion, melting away and
mixing together into something else.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Spinning, mixing, melting away, then spinning again...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And the next moment...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>Everything went black.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>That was how it all began...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>And how life as I knew it came to an end.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>At that point, I should have realized...
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>The reason I was brought to Hope's Peak Academy wasn't
because I had <CLT><CLT 3>ultimate good luck<CLT><CLT 4>.
<CLT>

steps.speaker: Makoto Naegi
steps.text:
<CLT 4>It was so I could experience <CLT><CLT 3>ultimate despair<CLT><CLT 4>...
<CLT>
